issue.title: Fluent server API integration
issue.body:
The app will need to connect to the Fluent web API to exchange data.

- scaffold a basic `fluent-api-service` that the app logic can reference
- create a basic implementation to demonstrate a simple call to the API

Do not worry about the DB structure and migrations for this ticket. Simply demonstrate a successful call to the API - even if it responds with an auth error. An api call that returns `403` would be considered successful.
